wiki.title: Marty Gearheart
wiki.extract: Gary Martin 'Marty' Gearheart (born September 15, 1961, in Zebulon, North Carolina) is an American politician and a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 27 since January 12, 2013. Gearheart served consecutively from November 2, 2010, until January 2013 in the District 24 seat.
